title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery — Months of a Restarted Plan and Disability Compensation Awards
content:
When a repayment plan paid by direct payment is set up on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** that has had a plan approved before, the months the balance is spread over depend on how the restarted plan is collected, read from whether the debtor holds a running **Disability Compensation** award.

| Plan approved before on the debt | Running Disability Compensation award | Months the balance is spread over |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | The months on the latest repayment plan request less 1 (restart months for compensation recipients) |
| Yes | No | The months on the latest repayment plan request less 2 (restart months for other debtors) |
| No | Either | As stated on the latest request; nothing taken off under this rule |

A plan counts as approved before when a granted repayment plan decision is already recorded on the debt. Whether an award is running is read from the status of the debtor's Disability Compensation award.

**Hypothetical cases.** A latest request for 10 months, an earlier plan granted, a running compensation award: spread over 9 months. The same with no running award: 8 months. No earlier plan granted: 10 months.
